matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the exact defect: the Bregman divergence definition in Section 2.3 uses D_R(y||p)=R(p)-R(y)-⟨∇R(y),p-y⟩ but the proofs (Lemma 2.1, Appendix B) silently use the standard definition D_R(y||p)=R(y)-R(p)-⟨∇R(p),y-p⟩. This is precisely the inconsistency introduced by gt_id 1.

No finding identifies the strong convexity inequality direction error in Section 2.4. Finding 4 discusses Section 2.4 but concerns bounded range vs. bounded Bregman divergence, not the inequality direction in the strong convexity definition.

Finding 2 identifies the exact normalization inconsistency: Section 2.1 defines Cal_T^D with a (1/T) factor, but Lemma 2.2 and the proofs use an unnormalized version, creating incompatible normalizations. This matches the defect where the sum ∑_t x_t(p) was changed to ∑_t x_t(p)/T.
